start: Members page, owner online, an .xlsx file with one row per member

steps.action: Tap the import button on Members
user_sees: Title 'Import members from Excel'
'Bring in your members from an Excel sheet or your old gym software'
'Your file' with 'Nothing is saved until you check the list and tap Add.'
Buttons 'Choose file' and 'Download sample file'
must_not: Anything saved before Add is tapped

steps.action: Tap 'Choose file' and pick the file
user_sees: 'Reading the file… a big sheet can take a few seconds.'
The columns matched to Name, Mobile and the rest; other columns ticked as extra details
must_not: The header row read as a member
A mobile column with a few landlines chosen over the real one

steps.action: Read the rows: to add, already members, 'Rows to check'. Fix one row and skip another ('Skip row <n>')
user_sees: Each problem in plain words on its row (for example 'No name.')
The fixed row moves to the rows to add
must_not: A date read as month-first in a day-first sheet
A row with a bad mobile added

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members'
user_sees: Progress while it saves in batches
Then the result with how many were added
must_not: A member added twice
The count on the button different from what is added

steps.action: Tap 'Open members'
user_sees: The new members in the list
must_not: Members missing that the result counted

start: Import page, other kinds of file

steps.action: Tap 'Download sample file', fill it and choose it
user_sees: Every column of the sample matched by itself
must_not: A sample the import itself cannot read

steps.action: Choose a .csv, then an old .xls, then a workbook with several sheets
user_sees: Each is read; for several sheets, a sheet to pick and later 'Import the next sheet: “<name>”'
must_not: Hindi names turned into boxes or question marks in a CSV
Only the first sheet readable

start: Import rows list where some rows have the mobile of a member already in the gym

steps.action: Read the line about them
user_sees: '<n> are already members of your gym (same mobile). For them:' with 'Skip them' and 'Fill in their blank details'
must_not: An existing member overwritten by default

steps.action: Pick 'Fill in their blank details'
user_sees: 'Only empty details are filled in. Their name, mobile and joining date stay as they are.'
The button becomes 'Add <n> members, update <m>' or 'Update <m> members'
must_not: 'Update 1 members' for one member
A filled-in detail replaced

steps.action: Tap the button
user_sees: The result counts the updated members; a member with nothing new says 'Already a member. Nothing new to fill in.'
must_not: A second member with the same mobile

start: Import file that also has plan, fees paid and valid-till columns

steps.action: Choose the file and check the rows
user_sees: Plan, start and end dates and the payment read for each row
must_not: A plan that ended last year shown as running
A fee read as a mobile

steps.action: Tap the Add button (it says 'Add <n> plans and payments' when every member is already in the gym)
user_sees: Members, their plans with dates and their receipts are saved under one import
must_not: A payment saved twice
Receipts counted in today's collection when the file says an older day

start: Import page, files and rows that cannot be taken

steps.action: Choose a file over 5 MB
user_sees: 'That file is over 5 MB. It is too big for a member list. Pick the Excel or CSV file with your members.'
must_not: The page freezing

steps.action: Choose a photo or a PDF
user_sees: 'That is not an Excel or CSV file. Pick a .xlsx, .xls or .csv file.'
must_not: A raw error

steps.action: Choose a sheet with more than 2000 member rows
user_sees: 'Only the first 2000 rows can be imported at once. <n> more rows were left out. Import them as a second file.'
must_not: Rows past 2000 dropped without a word

steps.action: Choose a sheet where every row has a problem
user_sees: Each row with its reason; the Add button cannot be tapped
must_not: An empty import reported as done

start: An import that is saving when the internet goes off

steps.action: Wait for the result
user_sees: '<n> rows are not saved yet. Tap “Try again” to send just these rows.'
'When the internet is back, tap “Try again” below, or import the same file again. Members already added are skipped, so nobody is added twice.'
must_not: Unsaved rows counted as added
A success message for a save that failed

steps.action: Turn the internet on and tap 'Try again'
user_sees: The waiting rows go in; the counts add up under the same import
must_not: Members added twice
Rows left out on purpose sent now

steps.action: If the plans and payments failed
user_sees: 'Members are saved, but not all their plans and payments. <why> Tap “Undo this import” below. Then import the same file again, so every payment comes in only once.'
must_not: A payment saved twice after importing again

steps.action: Under past imports tap 'Undo this import', read what goes and what stays, tap 'Yes, undo it'
user_sees: Button 'Undoing…'
'Import undone: <n> members, <n> plans with dates, <n> receipts and <n> plan names removed.' plus what was kept
must_not: Members the gym has used since (a visit, a new receipt) removed
A member who was in the gym before the import removed

steps.action: If the undo fails half-way
user_sees: 'The import was not fully undone. Check the internet and tap Undo again. What is already removed stays removed.'
must_not: The import shown as fully undone

start: Import with AI column matching, and a front-desk login on the same page

steps.action: Let the app match the columns with AI
user_sees: The columns matched; the owner can change any of them
must_not: Full mobiles, names, addresses or emails sent to the AI company (only masked cells of the first 5 rows and counts)
Matching that cannot be done by hand when the day's AI limit is used up

steps.action: As front desk, import a file that has plans and payments
user_sees: 'Only the owner can add plans and payments.'; members are added, plans and payments are left for the owner
must_not: Money records created by a front-desk login
An 'Undo this import' the server accepts from the front desk
